notes.title: Spring update Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Hunters![/h2]
Thank you for your incredible support and valuable feedback! We're rolling out a hotfix to address issues reported over the past few days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/f2f3df2cd03835f89782cca9b0c3f332d57efe79.png[/img]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Shroud Rust FX – Improved environmental effects for a more immersive experience.

notes.title: Early spring update.
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, hunters. [/h2]

With this spring update we are proud to present a fully reworked server management system, new gameplay mechanics, HUD enhancements, and quality of life improvements. 

[h2]🔥 Fully reworked server management system[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer game sessions are now displayed correctly. 
[*] Fully functional public and private sessions.
[*] Every game session now has a Lobby ID that can be shared for easily joining a session.
[/list]

[h2]📖 New Focus Mode [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/4cc71e93401b48c39cda1c352bdd9ee3117bbd85.png[/img]
In all haunted locations hunters can now find collectible journals related to the mysterious cult and the horrors that take place in SO BELOW.

🏚️ Cinematic scenes will play when interacting with the journals and focusable objects.
🕰️ Uncover lost fragments of the past and learn the secrets hidden in every map.
🔍 Learn more about the Ascendants, about HEXA, and piece together the truth behind every contract.

[h2]👁️ New Object: Hand Radar [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/ddf3fc36313ae59144489a903cba055a528ee051.png[/img]
The brand new Hand Radar is a powerful new investigation tool that can detect haunted objects and entities in a wide area of action. Available at the mobile stores.

🧩 Detect entities, haunted objects, and other hunters.
⚡ Minigame for charging the hand radar battery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/46e0f9a5a00923e9ea209951c29364ec5c79f687.jpg[/img]
[h2]⚙️ Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Balanced pricing for the hunting item store.
[*] Enhanced hand tool meshes and visuals.
[*] Greenwood forest map enhancements.
[*] Improved lamp FX & performance.
[*] Shroud ghost sound and visual enhancements.
[*] Nun balance updates.
[*] St. Philip Church now available for all entities.
[*] Dorje relic fixes for the shadows.
[*] Relic rumble feedback during entity fights.
[*] New EMF mesh and sound.
[*] New money transaction UI.
[*] Controller pointer for easier interaction.
[*] General map navigation balance.
[*] Complete HUD layout rework.
[*] Unified inventory for all kinds of objects.
[/list]

👁️ Get ready for a more immersive experience with this update. Dare enter the world of SO BELOW and unveiling its secrets. Please share your thoughts and comments, and as always, DON’T DIE!!!

notes.title: Haunted Christmas patch notes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Hunters, and happy holidays! 
[/h1]

We are happy to bring you a small but important patch for this holiday season.

Enhanced controller support: New controller mapping and overall improvements. Added rumble functionality based on pain.

New UI: Updated visuals and functionality of various menus and user interfaces. New Main menu, settings and key bindings menu pages.

New torch behavior: The torch and flashlight now appear turned on when changing inventory (easier to fight off wendigos).

Focus mode: New focus mechanic to expose lore and operate mechanical objects with the controllers. 

Xmas office: Seasonal Christmas decorations are on, get a picture with the team next to the tree. 

Greenwood forest enhancements: The Greenwood Forest is the first one to receive a bunch of lore exposition through diaries and focusable interest points. New aesthetics to fit the lore, as well as improved navigation with better lighting and landmarks, as well as maps.
 
Lure machine enhancements: Improvements to the lure machine regarding localization and functionality. 

Footprint mechanic: All the entities now display some sort of footprint, even when teleporting. This facilitates the environmental awareness of the hunters.

Crucifix journal page: New default journal page with information regarding the types of entities and their weaknesses, as well as a guide to crucifixes and cursed objects.

Added missing Localization: Some new objects were missing localization to Japanese, Italian and French. 

Bug fixing: We have been fixing the bugs that you guys reported since the last update. There’s maybe some more for you to discover though (please report bugs on our discord channel). 

As always, thank you for hunting entities for us. We hope you get scared and frustrated enough to finish the Wendigos, but happy enough to keep coming back. 
From Eonia Studio, Happy holidays!

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary update
notes.content:
[h1]Happy spooky season hunters, it’s been 
a while! [/h1]

Time flies when we do what we love, and with so many new things we have been doing to SO BELOW, almost 8 months went by very quickly. But alas, here we are, happy to share a gigantic update with you, our brave hunters. Expect new enemies, new maps, new mechanics, new lore, and new thrilling horror waiting to be discovered.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/933218dd864ceaec55840ff3c99cbb4d45cf7fbd.jpg[/img]

[h2]New enemies 
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/63d3dbdd7af27a1908822c3b51d5df3b4d79f579.jpg[/img]

[b]The Wendigo[/b] is the most dangerous beast-type entity in the entire game. Its new AI system handles two coordinated wendigos that use joint attacks and luring tactics against the hunter. Solve the
puzzles while holding the Wendigo menace, claim back the new 
[b]Greenwood Forest[/b] map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/0b4310c15d7d6628dfd8cc00835872725b8edc40.jpg[/img]

[b]Adepts [/b]are slow and very dangerous undead entities that were once human worshipers of Zultar. They are all-knowing creatures, so hiding is meaningless against it. With the Adepts we are proud 
to introduce our new insanity mechanic. Don’t stare into the Eye of the Adept for too long!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/aa43ea0e2631fcda60b061774b1aab7ce2885746.jpg[/img]

[b]The Revenant[/b] is the first immortal entity in SO BELOW, so defeating it is a matter of agility and luring tactics. You can still use crucifixes and other holy objects to slow it down. Don’t be a hero, if you get ahold of his severed finger, run for the portal! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/bfbb704966e56ffe5612ed75ec4909565dfe998d.jpg[/img]

[b]Watchers[/b] are a brand-new Shadow-type entity that can be defeated solely by the power of the flashing guns and photo cameras. However, looking directly into it will drive you mad, quickly. Avoid direct eye contact and you’ll be fine. 

New maps and old map improvements 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/928e900c14a98acc11b1dc04fe0c425df730389b.jpg[/img]

The [b]HEXA headquarters[/b] (the game lobby) has been completely redesigned and overhauled. With three main areas and dynamic music, the whole feel of the place has a new vibe.

The brand-new warehouse contains an item workshop, hidden areas, and overall a lot of hidden content waiting to be discovered.

We renovated the trophy room and implemented a new inspection mechanic to learn more about your findings during hunts.

We implemented a research area with a working cinema to study the history behind all those haunted locations.

Finally, a company history room, so you know who your employers are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/88960bacfb981561fa777a460aeecfc05b211921.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/607a89faa629715f381c26ae512ddade46a58129.jpg[/img]

Get ready for our [b]first map outdoors[/b]. Get lost in this beautifully haunting forest filled with secrets. Take a break from the oppressive interiors of the buildings of old and dive into the oppressive darkness of the Greenwood Forest.
These woods are home to the Wendigo, don’t trust your ears. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/e28a894feac76f2c620c1cfa2e26c8d5661b5fe9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reworks [/h2]

Every map received new treatments to adjust the new mechanics, so we took some time to fix a lot of tiny mistakes and weird situations in every map. We also added new cleansing stones for 
later updates related to the insanity and course mechanics. Speaking of new mechanics… 

[h2]New hunting tools [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/1626ae7eb429588da07a4d3bbde01f489fce70f0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Crucifixes and holy objects 
[/h2]

We expanded the Crucifix rooster with new holy objects: The good-old crucifix, the best all-round option for new hunters.

[list]
[*] [b]The cross of Brigid[/b], a handcrafted crucifix best suited against Banshees and other ghost-entities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]The Egyptian cross[/b], weak against shadows and banshees but powerful against undead entities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]The Palm Leaf cross[/b], best against beasts like the wendigo and the revenant, but weak against spirits.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]The Eye of God[/b], a traditional cross from Mexico that’s best against the Banshees and weak against physical beasts.

[*][b]The Bagua Mirror[/b], best against shadows but weak against physical entities. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/8402af36fa439a98a8a136072f90a8a5a8f8acbe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lure Machine 
[/h1]

We are happy to introduce a brand-new hunting tool, the Lure Machine. This device emits sounds specifically designed to attract specific entities. Just select the entity type and fire. The Lure Machine can “Aggro” the entity for a time, so use it to plan your hunts. 

[h1]Player inventory rework 
[/h1]

[b]New item animations and player controllers  
[/b]

For a long time we struggled with many hand objects and the ease of use of some of the hunting tools, so we revisited the whole controller and player animation systems. The renewed controller scheme is intuitive and responsive, but you have to try it yourself to see what we mean. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/46e0f9a5a00923e9ea209951c29364ec5c79f687.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]New in-game store 
[/b][/h2]

Although having all the tools available from the beginning is one of the staples of SO BELOW, we are aware that sometimes you just need extra gear (like a different crucifix or extra defibrillators). 
That’s why we implemented an item bundle store before each hunt, as well as a gear vending machine once the hunt has started. 
This will allow you to adjust your strategy accordingly.  

[h2]Event logger and text chat 
[/h2]
We got tons of feedback regarding the clarity of the game loop and in general how to do things in SO BELOW. That’s why we implemented a logger system. It provides live feedback from all 
that’s happening during the hunt. It shows relevant information regarding entity activity, cursed objects and tools, game objectives, map information, and more. This system also allows 
the players to chat with text, in case you are not ready to use the voice chat of the game. The color of the text can be chosen in the character selection menu. 

[h2][b]Lore 
[/b][/h2]

We implemented a new focusable object system that allows us to expand the lore of SO BELOW like never before. Now you can explore the haunted locations and learn more about the secret history of the Ascendants, their beliefs, and how it all relates to the entities haunting the many buildings acquired by HEXA. We also revisited the entity information at the beginning of every hunt. Our early design principles of keeping it ambiguous and mysterious backfired on us, so we made it as plain and simple as possible.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/25ee0d442fd359f4acf6d6c24e82b7e61260ce14.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/fe8043fd6fac7626e3b54ebf22392cd373fa3cd5.jpg[/img]

[h2]New insanity system 
[/h2]

We wanted more than a life bar, so we implemented a whole additional insanity system. Certain entities, objects, and even areas, can drive you insane and push you further into the dark corners of the mind, where you should not trust your senses. Of course, you are professional hunters, so just avoid situations that increase your insanity and you will get better overtime. Just, if you hear your own heartbeat, we recommend you to run and hide.

[h2]Item reworks 
[/h2]

We reskinned and reworked some old hand objects, such as the spectral microphone, the flashing gun, the torch, and the papyrus, to name a few. 

[h2]Papyrus 
[/h2]

The new Papyrus is now very easy to use. As a part of the whole controller rework, we realized that placing the papyrus was real trouble, so we made it easier than ever: just click to place. 

[h2]Flashing gun 
[/h2]

The flashing gun also changed skins, but more importantly, is operating controllers and its range has improved over past iterations. Now you can hold the trigger to ready your attack, and it no longer triggers itself automatically in the presence of an entity. This allows for better gameplay and strategy.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/b2f141c43c3e687e2c967fa9c39c25bb20e90837.jpg[/img]

The torch is now a powerful weapon against beast entities (like the wendigo and the revenant). You just need to keep the fire on and you can swing it as you would in a movie. Be careful though, they can also be broken by the entities. 

[h2]Spectral microphone 
[/h2]

The spectral microphone received a brand new skin and UI, prettier than ever. 

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[h2]Broken tutorial [/h2]

We got rid of the old tutorial level. It was confusing, it sometimes crashed the game, and it was very outdated. We decided to improve the overall information availability instead of implementing a tutorial. Frankly, we also hate tutorial levels to the bone, so yeah. 

[h2]Voice chat 
[/h2]

It might not seem like a big improvement, but after many months of struggle, the in-game voice chat is now working as we want it to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/14e743c1826abc4eedbcfceadef483f06b104203.jpg[/img]

We revisited the contract table. Now, if the generated contracts are too much for you and your team, or if the map you wanted to explore is not available, you can refresh them (for a fee) and tend to other contracts more in line to your taste. We also improved the contract information, so you can make better decisions.

Additionally, we implemented weekly contracts that will be updated regularly from the HEXA headquarters.  

Collaborations 

We have been working with local artists and creators to enrich the lore and atmosphere of SO BELOW. 

Special thanks to our friends: 

Luis Augusto García Nevárez, Gleis 11, Josué Villagrán and Mike Hance.
Thank you friends, we love you.

notes.title: Llorona madness / Panic at the mortuary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/1005270b0a880e17c054373bbf8c3ff07d0b6e11.jpg[/img]


We’re proud to finally show you our latest update, with [b]new content, revisited mechanics, and overall improvements that better the horror experience.[/b] We’ve been fixing a bunch of things and incorporating new ideas given to us by you, our hunters. We thank you dearly for being with us on this journey, your support is turning SO BELOW into something greater than we envisioned. Thanks.  


[previewyoutube=fZu8R_Y08Ms;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New content:[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/8abdcf2f0508b8ca60b8e03b1d95f3d7b455265d.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Bach Funeral Parlor. 
[/h2]-	Our newest map is a creepy mortuary facility, infested with recent paranormal phenomena. This map can be played with any entity (except for the Nun, which is unique to the Church). This is our first attempt at a map that’s just been abandoned, and its medium-to-small size make it perfect for solo contracts and speedruns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a086bae9c823e1e3963cb80d1b5c972af3555d01.jpg[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/6e5e2d26eacb37d956bac839bc67c2b6a1d03d87.jpg[/img]

[h2]New radar system.
[/h2]-	The new radar system allows the hunters to detect special objects, enemies, and other hunters in their surroundings. The device is divided into two parts: the portable antenna, and the radar monitor at the base. The idea es to team up with other hunters and coordinate through radio. The hunters can choose on the monitor who to track. Communication is key.

[h1]Reworks, fixes and improvements:
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/323157d56dfac68745c9e52683ab9440bcf2771f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Llorona madness.
[/h2]This time we bring you a new revisited version of one of our most popular entities: La Llorona. For a long time, we felt that the Llorona entity was somewhat underdeveloped. That’s why we not only changed the models of the whole family, but we implemented a transformation function that reflects the state of the entities (roaming, hunting, searching, etc.), making it a little easier to navigate the maps safely. This in time inspired us to revisit her behavior and that of her children. 
Now the children can call upon their mother when disturbed by the hunters, as well as transforming and being able to damage the hunters if the perturbations go too far. 
The whole Llorona experience has been significantly improved. Now their behavior make for a very dynamic set of encounters. 

[h2]Voice chat improvements.
[/h2]
Proximity chat and radio communications are essential to immersion in SO BELOW, and the previous implementation of the radios was—put slightly—a nightmare. Finally, after many hours of troubleshooting, we are proud to announce that the in-game voice chat is now stable and fun to use. This means we have a consistent proximity chat experience and the corresponding sound effects on radio and while dead. Please, go ahead and give it a try, for there could still be some bugs left to be found. 

[h2]Player camera improvements
[/h2]
The hunters can now enjoy a much better camera experience with smooth transitions and improved hand object positions. This means that tools such as hand cameras are much more comfortable (and practical) to use. Additionally, we’ve decided to completely get rid of the immersive mode (headbob), for it caused many more problems than its worth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/e43882d44abc10cbc402691c54dee277a547aadb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quality-of-life improvements. 
[/h2]
Sprinting doors: Now the hunters can rush through a haunted location by sprinting towards doors, providing a much more agile experience. This, however, causes a lot of noise and can prompt entities to investigate the area. Escaping entities is now an important factor. And, on that same note…

[h2]General entity behavior improvements 
[/h2]
The general haunting behavior of most entities has been improved by binding the entity speed to the distance relative to the hunter. This means that, in principle, the hunters can outrun most of the entities by sprinting gracefully across the map. This does not apply to teleporting entities, such as the shadow. Additionally, the entities now forget the player position after some time, allowing the possibility to hide (remember that crouching is your friend). 

[h2]Revisited hunting objects. 
[/h2]
We are constantly thinking about new ways to improve the hunting experience, and that’s why we’ve brought back the Geiger Counter and the Glowing Sticks with new functionalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/67c3cefa48e674cfd99520de78788e2df337672d.jpg[/img]

-	[b]New glowstick system[/b]. The glowstick item has been revamped to offer 8 individual glowsticks in one pouch, meaning hunters can now easily mark their path through mazes or leave some sort of indicator anywhere they want. 
-	[b]New Geiger counter.[/b] The Geiger counter is back, and this time it offers a mor comprehensive experience. The device can detect entities and haunted objects, but it also detects overall paranormal activity, meaning that when there is an ongoing attack, its reading will go through the roof. 
-	[b]Defibrillator rework . [/b]The defibrillator got a new look and feel, as well as an important overhaul: it now has more charges. Now hunters can revive the player multiple times (3 times per defibrillator) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/44b33a72a583b1f77c01bc6c66e5ccedc392f312.jpg[/img]

[h2]Revisited maps.
[/h2]
We went through all the maps in scrutiny looking for missing mechanics or weird situations. All maps were improved in systems and decorations to some degree, meaning a more consistent experience and a refreshing look (especially in older maps, like the orphanage).
Some changes include:
-	Additional tool spawn rate increased. This was done in order to have more crucifixes and other tools available while exploring.
-	More audio elements and cues. Some maps lacked a few audio cues and tricks, such as haunted areas having a different reverb to evoke a haunted feeling. 
-	Revisited decorations and lore consistency. Many paintings, symbols and other decorations within the maps were updated to fit the overarching cult narrative. 

[h2]Game audio improvements
[/h2]
The game atmosphere is very important to us, so we added more subtle sounds and a few game sound mechanics that noticeably improve the game feeling and immersion. These things include new physical sounds, new ghost sounds, improvements to the footstep system, and more. Also, both the Nachtgeist and the Llorona sound sets were improved as a part of the Llorona madness overhaul. Additionally, thanks to your help, we fixed some character voice lines that were mixed. 

[h2]Additional Bug fixes
[/h2]
We are always reading and learning about new bugs, and thanks to that we’ve fixed and improved a lot of small things here and there (thanks to everyone reporting on our discord server). A couple honorable mentions are:

-	Doors clipping randomly. Has it happened to you? A very annoying bug where the doors clipped between positions. This caused open doors to appear closed and vice versa. 
-	Objects changing state after changing object selection on inventory. Meaning that sometimes certain consumable objects (like crosses, defibrillators, etc.) could be “reset” by this bug. 

And that’s all we have for now, dear hunters. We will focus the following weeks on performance improvements and also finishing a new map (spoiler alert: our first forest map). As always, we thank you for your continued support and, especially, for your feedback. Although we are a very small team, with all your help, this now feels more like a big and loyal community. Thank you very much everyone.

notes.title: Worst Nightmares Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/232038e4d3128f4c5f4d1975e01fea8f31b19282.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gear up, hunters! [/h1]

We’re excited to release our latest SO BELOW update, where we put our most experienced hunters to the test with our new difficulty system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/d154def4547820399032f1c5afd5ff75b13d30bd.png[/img]

Now, hunters can pick contracts with a variety of game modifiers (and get paid handsomely) and also choose the relative boss difficulty. This means more money, more action, more pain, and more gain.

Depending on the default difficulty of the contract, you will get a set of modifiers that can range from a few visual challenges to survival mode with several entities at the same time. 

Environment and entity modifiers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a2c04cd85de3696a625ab664b97f4a330f849cd1.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Unreliable electronics[/b][/h3]
All electronic devices tend to malfunction during the hunt.

[h3][b]Midnight Veil[/b][/h3]
All-encompassing darkness throughout the hunt. Compromised viewing distance. 

[h3][b]Cursed destiny[/b][/h3]
No cleansing altars on the map.

[h3][b]No EMF[/b][/h3]
Hunt the entities without any EMF.

[h3][b]Light my fire[/b][/h3]
No flashlights, only lighter and environmental lights. 

[h3][b]Diminished perception[/b][/h3]
No pin icons. Only voice lines.  

[h3][b]Survival mode[/b][/h3]
No defibrillators, just one try. 

[h3][b]Icy embrace[/b][/h3]
Cold weather reduces max player stamina by 20%.

[h3][b]Suffocating fog[/b][/h3]
Low visibility due to a high density mist in the hunt location.

[h3][b]Phantom menace [/b][/h3]
Additional Geist entities reported at the hunting location.

[h3]Other difficulty adjustments:[/h3]

Now haunted items can spawn on different locations depending on the difficulty. 
Improvements to the base ghost system. This means that we can now spawn many Nachtgeists at the same time depending on the difficulty. (Challenge for expert hunters only)

notes.title: The Nun of St. Philip Church.
notes.content:
[h1]The Nun of St. Philips Church.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/5864cf68a921083138bcad1453d928e73e433605.png[/img]

Gear up hunters! We’ve been working like crazy these past months and we are proud to present a whole new experience in So Below. 

[h2]New entity: The Nun.[/h2]

The Nun of St. Philip Church is the most dangerous entity in the whole game, and she is currently haunting a new map, St. Philip Church. She is the most aggressive and powerful entity to date, able to spawn creatures from the underworld and a relentless hunter. For this entity we created a whole new map and a set of new mechanics and experiences, which also impact and improve the rest of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a8fc5f366c3328088348db6c275fc4dca17464fd.png[/img]


[h2]New map: St. Philip Church. [/h2]

Get lost within the walls of St. Philip Church, the holy seat of the Church of the Ascending Mind, an extinct cult that delved too deep into ancient knowledge and was mysteriously disbanded years ago. Traces of the cultists and their practices are still present throughout the Church. The place is thoroughly haunted by the Nun, as the locals know her. However, the intel team believes that she might be the former leader of the complex and prominent member of the Ascendants: Agnes Montrose. This new location is filled with secrets and danger, we advise going in teams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/9f4448b1d5e11c4001beb17c84244d86744cdf98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/06208ac5d2b4a7f3920091720c6374876ca2632d.png[/img]


[h3]St. Philip Church features:[/h3]

Go deeper: St. Philip’s Church sits above two catacomb systems, one of which has several entrances through the Church, and a second, deeper catacomb that can be accessed through a special entrance. Be mindful, after going below, there is no turning back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/84550b63aa3ff2ccc8dea1da1c8b1253542d6c8b.png[/img]


Explore the home of the Ascendants: Discover the secret rituals and practices of the Church of the Ascending Mind, learn their history, and unveil their downfall through the devastation they left behind. 

[h3]Reimagined Lore to fit an over-arching cult narrative. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/665eb3004e023fc9bfbafe8d63ec17498ae4a6af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/8f69c9168267a3df91019ea445691bd744da68c1.png[/img]

Symbology and new devices and puzzles: The Church of the Ascending Mind was a very symbol-driven cult, they used a few writing and symbol systems to control different rituals and challenges.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/5d1f1f8515a6769b6b53ea9172f1e2dcefcc0825.png[/img]

[h2]New Mechanics:[/h2]

[h3]Enhanced enemy behavior. [/h3]

The Nun uses different fear tactics depending on the player’s behavior. The fight can be fierce and unpredictable, or tranquil and mysterious depending on the player. 

[h3]New Sanguine Cross. [/h3]

New cross item to fight off entities. This crucifix cannot be destroyed by enemies as the wooden crosses. Instead, it consumes the blood of the user to refill its power. Use it wisely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/65ed129a007130fcdbafccdc20bde7daacc081a4.png[/img] 

[h3]New curse mechanic. [/h3]

The Nun can curse the players based on their behavior, harassing them, causing paranormal activity to rise around the player, and even teleporting them to the spirit realm. The curse of the Nun can be undone by approaching the new healing stones scattered throughout the Church. This cursing system will be implemented on past and future entities, enhancing the paranormal experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/e8341d683647245f0dd9437a83259ec7cd8b5363.png[/img]

[h3]Enhanced ghost mode.[/h3] 

New improved ghost experience. Ghost players can now hold gear and objects, as well activate objects around the maps, open and close doors, drawers, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/716cc499b858e73026a66599770e204ac9c54522.png[/img]

[h2]Additional features:[/h2]

[h3]New contract system. [/h3]

New game selection system by contracts. The new system allows the player to select contracts both by location and by entity, as well as special urgent assignments. Future updates will also enrich the information provided by the contracts, as well as difficulty-to-payment balance. 

The blue contracts are always free to pick, but the player cannot select the type of entity and their payment is subject to performance. The beige contracts are identified by the type of entity, but they do have an in-game cost. The new Nun contract is available through the black contracts.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/be4867b7b48ef49d9165a386380b23db6d84a893.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/69db0166a087334f955fd34e623665519dac334e.png[/img]

[h3]Journal redesign and functionality. [/h3]

The player journal is now easy to read and with more information and details regarding the entity. Further updates will improve the quality of information and also provide deeper lore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/8d68626e62b586dd48bc4093a486d1e9ddb2a7d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/51cf483c8d3aa396d213aba09c58b283452448fa.png[/img]


[h3]User interface improvements. [/h3]

New UI for interaction with certain world objects (doorknobs, candles, light switches, etc.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/2b2a4ea6cb732825ef3841c823a33ffaff9f109c.png[/img]

New place mechanic implementation. Now the player can see the objects to be placed in certain expected locations (for example the burning pits in the crying lady ritual).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/874f68674dca1ea624edc1e2edd9e5e7c28860d4.png[/img]


[h3]In-game voice chat system improvements. [/h3]

Now the radio mechanic is fully functional. This is the way the dev team intended it to work. The voice used in-game exist physically in the world, meaning that it can be heard by players and ghosts. Use the radio to communicate over long distances and to listen for paranormal activity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/a601de99b4a81ba8dafecf9b9481cd50e9a21d72.png[/img]

[h3]New colab with Random British Dude. [/h3]

New skin and voice lines made by our friend Random British Dude. Available now as a playable character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/3486ac468409f32284f6565f05700b370d275fa3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: No headbob update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/eaf07dac0cbcc393ab7d1722a5b5b7bad550c5a2.gif[/img]
[h1]Great news everyone![/h1]
We have been listening to you, and we are proud to announce that we successfully refactored the camera system to avoid the motion sickness caused by the previous camera implementation (the headbobbing issue). Now, this doesn’t mean that the old camera mode is entirely gone, you can now activate it on the menu by choosing the “immersive mode” in the game options (deactivated by default). Also, if you prefer a third-person view, you can switch modes by pressing “U”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/c31ededb1eaad95c4a43c869c13eabd811c28a0e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] The object-dropping system was improved; we solved the bugs regarding the dropping of objects out of boundaries.
[*] Sprint priority. Now sprinting overrides any other character state (aiming, camera, journal, etc.), this improves escape tactics. 
[*] Added 2K resolution.
[*] Improvements and stability when connecting to an ongoing hunting session. (Camera offset looking at the floor). 
[*] Menu cello cue correction to avoid sound overlapping. 
[*] New ending sequence for the Llorona (the Witch), new music, more time to escape the cave system, more dust and rockfall. 
[*] Improvements to the difficulty balance depending on the number of players. 
[*] Size adjustment for the Undead ritual room.
[*] Tutorial crash fix, cockroaches removed.
[/list] 

However, we still need your help. If you encounter any issue with the new camera mode or any other issue, please refer to our discord channel to report it. It really goes a long way.

https://discord.gg/yg4pQyME

notes.title: So Below Patch Notes - Version v0.1.3.0.02f04e
notes.content:
Hello and welcome, fellow hunters!

We are excited to announce a new feature in So Below that we’re sure you'll love - the character store! You can now use in-game currency to purchase unique characters, skins, and backpacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/96b57f24dd8ea6ae08db9b48b1b40566c136721f.png[/img]

We know how important it is to have a character that reflects your unique style and personality, and with our new character store, now you can. We are working towards the future addition of more personalization options, such as decoration for the backpacks and haunting gear skins. Now all hunters will be able to show their expertise by wearing the official Hexa uniform. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/c6f8ee09100556ef81097961f16174ba446a6000.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/55970ae3a8b5431c81b7f2574f072c2e81cb903d.png[/img]

New Features:
[list]
[*]Introducing the new Hexa Store. Players can now purchase new skins and more with the new in-game currency.
[*]Introducing the new Character Packo! This pack includes a new character designed for our friend Packo, aka the streamer known as Gamehauntings, complete with unique cosmetic items.
[*]Introducing the new Hunting Equipment, the Tablet! This item shows you the approximate location of the ghost and other hunters in the game, making it easier for players to track their targets and avoid getting lost.
[/list]

Gameplay Changes:
[list]
[*]Various gameplay changes have been made to improve the overall experience for players. These include improvements to hunt tracking data, experience and payment calculations and bug fixes for various achievements.
[*] General rework of all character models to greatly improve performance and aesthetics.
[*] Improvements to the hunt summary after each session. Players can now see a summary of their performance, including the earned experience, collected rewards, and captured ghosts.
[/list]
Bug Fixes and Improvements:
[list]
[*] Various bugs and glitches have been fixed to improve the overall game experience. Huge thanks to all the people who have been reporting bugs on our discord and on steam. 
[*] The user interface has been updated to provide a more seamless and enjoyable experience for players.
[/list]
Thank you for playing SO BELOW! We hope you enjoy these new features and changes, and we look forward to seeing you in the game.

Good hunting!

notes.title: New map Yorke Station!
notes.content:
So Below huge update today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/dc782b54dcdb70e97d49e16db92e116e05e51111.jpg[/img]

We are excited to present a whole new map: Yorke Station.

This small map was created for lone hunters looking for an exciting fast-paced experience. Yorke Station is an old subway station that was abandoned after a series of findings and unfortunate events. Its small area is ideal for newcomers and hunters who enjoy a rather fast-paced challenge. Don’t let it fool you, this place is abandoned for a good reason.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/02dfb8727825891b4e6bff6c090be5cae8324bd7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/18d41c5792d0802adddf59a6df6e6e4b1949ff0f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/5aad83fa555a1bd35b3babf7239be60dcde5907d.png[/img]

New playable tutorial! 

You can now find the new tutorial mode on the main menu. Here you can safely learn the practical applications of ghost-hunting gear and the standard ritual knowledge required by HEXA. However, a true hunter is always attentive to the patterns and behaviors of their prey. Learn as much as you can here, because out there, on the field, you will be completely on your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42978238/d31879516903e1c1d3bbdb2d1210e1b5746d73ce.png[/img]
